trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.short: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on its own when the last one lands.

steps.t: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks strands and the character finales.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only interaction that can be missed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.short: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing; the trophy pops when it ends.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.short: Complete Chapter 1.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 1's missions; the trophy pops at the start of Chapter 2.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.short: Complete Chapter 2.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's missions; the trophy pops at the start of Chapter 3.
From Chapter 2 you can switch between Jason and Lucia — start the partner trophies now.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.short: Complete Chapter 3.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's missions; the trophy pops at the start of Chapter 4.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner and Yasmani's jewelry jobs — the robbery tools.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.short: Complete Chapter 4.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4's missions; the trophy pops after the final mission of the chapter.
The Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' opens the bank vault robberies — do it when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.short: Complete the final mission.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission; the trophy pops when it ends.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.short: Complete the mission Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; the trophy pops during the mission.
Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.short: Complete The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; the trophy pops during the mission.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.short: Complete Child's Play.

steps.t: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4; the trophy pops during the mission.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.short: Complete Headliners.

steps.t: Play Headliners in Chapter 4; the trophy pops during the mission.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.short: Complete VCIA Takedown.

steps.t: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; the trophy pops during the mission.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.short: Complete Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5; the trophy pops during the mission.
Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.short: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist — the longest grind in the list.

steps.t: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts.
The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts.
The only lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it is doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.short: Land 250 stunts of any kind; the checklist wants 300.

steps.t: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to repeat.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.short: Try all 9 activity types once.

steps.t: The tracker counts 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, performing a stunt.
Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most unlock naturally while working on other trophies.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you have not tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a Gold Medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.short: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 ranges.

steps.t: There are 12 Shooting Range locations holding 42 challenges between them.
Gold every challenge; the medals are not hard, and only 100% needs all 42.
Playing the ranges also raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each location.
trophies.short: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations.

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun locations holding 42 drone races; win at least one race at each location.
All 42 drone time trials are also needed for 100%.
The races count toward the race trophies too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.short: Win 20 different races.

steps.t: There are 40 unique race locations; win 20 different ones.
100% wants 30 of 40 races won, so keep going past 20.
Race challenge gold medals (10 of 13) are a separate 100% line.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.short: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location marked with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge and beat him.
Fishing also feeds the Focus meter — each fish landed adds about 10%.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.short: Finish one arcade game.

steps.t: There are 4 arcade games ('Video Games'): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable at the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world.
Finish all levels in one game once — you do not need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.short: Finish Andy's final mission — a Lucia-only questline in Chapter 3.

steps.t: In Chapter 3 as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The questline stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.short: Finish Kenton's final mission — 7 shipwrecks of treasure diving.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls; he is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento.
He marks purple treasure chests on the map; find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back — 7 shipwrecks in total.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up.
Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.short: Finish Billy's final mission at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy's questline is marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.short: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands — not every side questline counts.

steps.t: Only certain strands count; Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.
Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Watch Yago's timed race in Chapter 3 — it carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears.
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.short: Finish Randy's final mission — deliver 16 sports cars from his wish list.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, Randy gives you a wish list of 16 sports cars; the Zorrusso is delivered during that mission.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he is marked with the green RK icon in west Vice City.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it back to his garage — good condition pays more.
Cars turn up most in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.short: Finish Tyrone's final mission — shut down the Synthetic Labs.

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City; this is Jason-only.
Destroy the labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter' until Tyrone gives you 'Spin On This'.
All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.short: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — with both characters.

steps.t: There are 18 spots in 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation FIRST: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — it vanishes after Chapter 1.
Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the last spot needs both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
100% needs only 15 of 18, but this trophy needs all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.short: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason-only.

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive it); meet him in Lummox County for 'Veteran Hunted'.
He marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him.
He gives you the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' — one clean shot keeps the carcass pristine and pays more.
Which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed — track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.short: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.

steps.t: There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; complete any 3 full sets.
100% wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3.
Cards are found in the world, not bought — check the map's Exploration layer for set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.description: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.
trophies.short: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.

steps.t: Hold up + R1 to scan objects in the world; there are far more than 100 (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more).
Scan as you travel — landmarks and curiosities count the same as any other scan.
100 scans are also a 100% checklist line.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.short: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.

steps.t: There are 80 challenges; this trophy needs any 50, and 100% needs any 70 — so you can skip the hardest 10.
Track them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while working on other trophies.
Save this for last, then pick the easiest remaining challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star wanted level with your partner and escape.
trophies.short: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape.

steps.t: Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together; call your partner with hold-right + triangle.
Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest route, as the helicopter cannot see you there.
The trophy pops after you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner, wanted level never dropping.
trophies.short: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, wanted level never dropping.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner and hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while the police chase you the whole time.
Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level — if the stars fade to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well; the trophy can pop ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.short: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning is enough, no driving needed.

steps.t: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch; scan them with the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1) as they pass.
Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic — a new unique vehicle adds itself to the database on scan.
100% wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Use Combat Focus to down 5 enemies in one use.
trophies.short: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted; it drains the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first — eat or drink, wash up at home, or take Adrenaline to extend the slowdown.
Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556; it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.
Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.short: Steal a passenger plane docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly away.

steps.t: At Vice City International Airport, take a large passenger plane docked to a boarding bridge — airfield planes do not count; gates E3/E4 work.
Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops at distance.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.short: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station.

steps.t: Tanks stand on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County (Goose Key).
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot until the trophy pops.
Save first — the base is guarded.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.short: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and the jewelry store robberies.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm); the gadget stays in your inventory.
In the back room, find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.short: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — it introduces vault robberies and the first one is automatic.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for van tips (purple icons); do his earlier Payday Loan jobs first to unlock the tips.
Vaults give a 4-star wanted level instantly — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles; all 8 vaults are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.short: Rob an armored truck and escape.

steps.t: Robbing a large bank vault in the Chapter 4 mission counts as robbing an armored truck — you tail the truck to the bank.
Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Either way, the trophy pops only after you escape the red heat radius — use a Pay 'n' Spray if needed.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.short: Explore all of Leonida — unfog the whole map.

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map — the trophy counts explored areas, not collectibles.
A plane is the fastest way to sweep the fogged regions.
It pops once no black fog remains on the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.short: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

steps.t: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations; one per gang is enough for this trophy, all 39 for 100%.
Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them; many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view.
trophies.short: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini; drink it standing next to the bar.
KeenGamer lists this trigger as still being confirmed, so treat the bar-and-drink as the best-known method, not a guarantee.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Drive the blue Banshee from the showroom through its window.
trophies.short: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in a blue Banshee.

steps.t: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window.
You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Only the blue Banshee counts — it is a reference to the Banshee from GTA III; the trophy pops a moment after you reach the street.
KeenGamer lists this method as still unconfirmed, so if the window smash does not pop it, re-check the car is the blue Banshee.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling.
trophies.short: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling.

steps.t: During the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (marked automatically), go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.

Take the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first).
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup — and you do not need all 3 in one visit; the robbery icon respawns, so you can finish the rest later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.description: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
trophies.short: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.t: Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon); you need it maxed on both characters at once.
Buy a gym membership and work out with your partner along (call them with hold-right + triangle) — while one trains, the other completes training automatically.
Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
trophies.short: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

steps.t: Every robbery, fight and escape feeds the count — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your progress toward 500.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see each action register as a demon face on screen.
It fills passively while working on other trophies; if it is short at the end, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast — at Psycho or Irredeemable the cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.description: It wasn't supposed to end like this.
trophies.short: Method unknown — the only trophy no guide has pinned down.

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
KeenGamer also lists it as an unconfirmed hidden trophy.
Do the Payday Loan jobs when they appear and keep a save from the prologue area — this is the best lead anyone has, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.short: Complete the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel — at night, solo.

steps.t: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, alone.
If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light; approach it and it drops the abducted woman.
Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside — the trophy pops.
The spawn is slightly random: if the car is not there, drive away and come back. KeenGamer lists this as unconfirmed, so treat it as the best-known method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Use a drive-by melee attack to hit 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds.
trophies.short: Kick 10 pedestrians with a melee drive-by in 60 seconds.

steps.t: Ride any motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with square within 60 seconds.
Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
KeenGamer lists the precise method as still being confirmed — if 10 kicks do not pop it, check the count restarted cleanly and try a busier street.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.short: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

steps.t: The $100,000 is cumulative across every shop type.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive items.
There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more; spending during normal play gets most of the way there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.short: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).

steps.t: Garages become buyable after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone.
Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the app — the 4 story garages do not count.
Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to raise the $160,000.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.short: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Buy garages first — each adds parking spots; then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
